name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 3px outer glow to every interactive element. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus states without overwhelming the design. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on some elements, but the glow improves visibility for users with low vision or in bright light.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with 3px glow shrinks already-tight touch targets on mobile—users mis-tap. A 1px ring with 2px glow keeps the 44px touch target intact while still signaling focus. Test with Playwright MCP on iOS/Android to confirm tap accuracy and contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 1px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2px outer glow on every interactive element. This keeps touch targets at 44px while still giving keyboard users a clear, visible focus indicator. The trade-off is slightly less contrast for some users, but the glow compensates and maintains WCAG 2.2 AA. Playwright MCP will verify tap accuracy and contrast on mobile.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring with 2px glow risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA contrast for users with low vision—especially on light backgrounds where #005FCC’s blue may not stand out enough. A 1.5px ring with 2px glow balances touch target integrity and contrast better; test it with Playwright MCP on iOS/Android at 200% zoom to confirm both tap accuracy and color contrast.
